in_hebrew.name: Ari
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Little, or Lion of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ari הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Ariadne was a Cretan princess who gave Theseus a thread to follow in the labyrinth to slay the Minotaur. In Hebrew, Ari means 'lion'. In the Christian tradition, Ari can be considered a name for those who embody courage and faith.
